rows.text: She’s out for the season but will remain with the team and work with their medical staff for her rehab.
rows.name: Sania Feagin

rows.text: Tough news for Sania Feagin, who signed a development deal with the Fire and had yet to make her debut — the team just announced that she’s out for the season with a torn ACL.
rows.name: Sania Feagin
